title: HorseSpa Farm
specs: 158-acre property with trails around perimeter and throughout
All-metal barn with 12x12 stalls, double stall with paddock, automatic waterers, ceiling fans, rubber mats
3-sided large run-ins with concrete floors and mats in each pasture
Indoor wash stall with hot water and indoor grooming stall
Boarders' instructors/trainers must have liability insurance and endorse HorseSpa Farm and Wendy Parker as additional insured

options.name: Sick Stall
options.detail: Stall available for horses without stalls, no reservations required, stall cleaned daily.

options.name: 2nd Meal/Med Option
options.detail: Evening meal or medication brought to pastured horse.

options.name: Pasture Board Only
options.detail: Horse stays in pasture with access to grass pastures and hay, fed grain and supplements individually, stall access in emergencies.

options.name: Pasture Board Plus Stall
options.detail: Reserved stall for owner's use as needed, horse fed as above, bedding additional cost.

blurb: HorseSpa Farm provides boarding with a focus on maximum turnout and individualized care. Horses have access to pastures, hay, grain, and medical administration. Facilities include stalls, paddocks, trails, and riding arenas on a 158-acre property.
extraNote: Bedding charged at cost, pay by the bag · Sick stall available without reservation, $5/day
